text.offer: Ah, my fellow freedom fighter. My troops have need of more equipment. This war costs us much, and I do not have the luxury of a large treasury like the other leaders do. Bring me a long sword and I will not forget your loyalty.
text.progress: Jonas D'Accor's troops need equipment: bring him a long sword.
text.complete: Ah, excellent. I will definitely put this to good use. You have shown your dedication to the cause.
